claims.text: The resort is centrally located near Disney World, Universal Orlando, SeaWorld and the outlet malls, yet its lush natural setting makes it feel removed.

findings.quote: The resort is centrally located near Disney World,
SeaWorld, and the outlet malls, but thanks to its lush, natural setting, it feels removed.

claims.text: The Lazy River flows through lush tropical greenery with jets, waterfalls and bridges.

findings.quote: flowing through lush tropical greenery with jets, waterfalls and bridges from one zone to the next

claims.text: All three waterslides at the Headwaters Slide Tower are heated for year-round fun.

findings.quote: Make your way to the Headwaters Slide Tower for sensational thrills and epic good times on three high-flying slides.
All three slides are heated for year-round fun.

claims.text: Splash Cove has swimming, the AquaVenture aqua course, the PlayVenture playground, and games and crafts at the JW studio.

findings.quote: Splash Cove is home to swimming, the AquaVenture aqua course, PlayVenture playground, and games and crafts at the JW studio.

claims.text: The Oasis is a serene firepit lounge area of the waterpark with a private plunge pool.

findings.quote: The exclusive Oasis is a serene firepit lounge area of the waterpark, ideal for having a relaxing drink around a fire or taking a dip in a private plunge pool.

claims.text: The 18-hole championship golf course is a Certified Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary.

findings.quote: The 18-hole championship course is a Certified Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary and tests the abilities of every skill level.

claims.text: As part of the Grande Lakes complex, the JW Marriott shares facilities with the neighboring Ritz-Carlton Orlando, including the Greg Norman-designed golf course and a 40,000-square-foot spa.

findings.quote: As part of the Grande Lakes resort complex, the JW Marriott shares many of its facilities with the neighboring Ritz-Carlton Orlando, including an 18-hole Greg Norman–designed championship golf course and a 40,000-square-foot spa.

claims.text: Rooms feature luxury bedding, marble bathrooms and 65-inch HDTVs.

findings.quote: Stretch out in modern rooms offering luxury bedding, marble bathrooms, 65-inch HDTVs, and sweeping views of our luxury resort in Orlando.

claims.text: Marble-tiled bathrooms have separate walk-in showers and soaking tubs.

findings.quote: Marble-tiled bathrooms are roomy, with separate walk-in showers and soaking tubs.

claims.text: High-floor suites have a balcony overlooking the golf course and lakes.

findings.quote: high-floor suites with a balcony overlooking the golf course and lakes

claims.text: Family suites feature a king bedroom and a separate bunk bed area, with VIP check-in and nightly surprises chosen around the children's ages and interests.

findings.quote: Settle into a spacious family suite featuring a luxury king bedroom and a separate bunk bed area. From VIP check-in and personalized itinerary planning to nightly surprises selected around your children's ages and interests

claims.text: The resort uses fresh, organic ingredients from its on-site Primo Garden and Whisper Creek Farm.

findings.quote: we use fresh, organic ingredients from our on-site Primo Garden and Whisper Creek Farm

claims.text: Grande Lakes Waterpark has a lazy river, the Headwaters Slide Tower with three waterslides, restful lagoons and the Oasis VIP firepit lounge.

findings.quote: Grande Lakes Waterpark features several areas to play in and is home to a lazy river, Headwaters Slide Tower with three waterslides, restful lagoons, and the Oasis VIP firepit lounge.

claims.text: The resort sits on a lush 500-acre property at the headwaters of the Florida Everglades.

findings.quote: Located on a lush, 500-acre property
The towering JW Marriott Orlando sits on 500 acres at the headwaters of the Florida Everglades.

claims.text: Grande Lakes Sports offers sunrise safaris, fishing on one of eleven lakes, a hidden mountain bike trail and falconry.

findings.quote: Watch the headwaters of the Everglades come alive on a sunrise safari, test your fishing skills on one of our eleven lakes, tackle our hidden mountain bike trail, or delve
into the intriguing world of falconry.

claims.text: Signature spa therapies use herbs from the resort's organic garden, honey from its resident bees and citrus from local orchards.

findings.quote: Signature therapies, including massages and body treatments, incorporate herbs from the resort's organic garden, honey from its resident bees, and citrus from local orchards

claims.text: The golf course and the spa are shared with the neighboring Ritz-Carlton Orlando rather than exclusive to the JW Marriott.

findings.quote: the JW Marriott shares many of its facilities with the neighboring Ritz-Carlton Orlando, including an 18-hole Greg Norman–designed championship golf course and a 40,000-square-foot spa.
